stage.note: Prior rounds: seed (Uncork Capital participated since seed), Series B ($30M initial + $35M B2 extension = $65M total per Coder's own blog, led by Georgian for the B2 tranche, with Notable, Redpoint, Uncork also participating).

total_funding_usd.basis: indexed.vc aggregator: 'Coder... has raised $419.2M in total across 8 rounds, most recently a $90.0M Series C round in Apr 2026' — no primary source confirms this cumulative figure; confirmed rounds alone (Series B $65M + Series C $90M) total only $155M, so the aggregator total includes unconfirmed/undisclosed earlier rounds (seed, Series A) and should be treated as a rough estimate.
total_funding_usd.quote: Coder is a Cloud company based in Austin, United States, founded in 2017. It has raised $419.2M in total across 8 rounds, most recently a $90.0M Series C round in Apr 2026.

last_round.quote: Coder, a leader in AI development infrastructure, today announced a $90 million Series C led by funds managed by KKR, a leading global investment firm, with participation from Qube Research & Technologies (QRT), Uncork Capital, and other existing investors.

revenue.basis: GetLatka estimate (third-party aggregator, not confirmed by the company); note TechCrunch (2024) reported 'Revenue doubled last year' and expected to double again in 2024, but gave no dollar figure.
revenue.quote: Coder Technologies generated an estimated $53.1M in annual revenue in 2025.

note: Founded 2017 in Austin, TX by Ammar Bandukwala, Kyle Carberry and John Andrew Entwistle (Entwistle departed 2021; Rob Whiteley is CEO). Open-source core (AGPL-3.0, 80K+ GitHub stars) with a paid 'Enterprise/Premium' self-hosted tier — revenue comes from licensing/support, not from selling compute. Series C (Apr 2026) was led by two of its own enterprise customers, KKR and QRT, both of whom use Coder internally for governed AI-agent development. As of the 2024 Series B2 raise, Coder had 'nearly $80 million in the bank' and ~50 employees; by 2025/2026 GetLatka estimates ~483 employees and ~$53.1M ARR, though that headcount figure looks high relative to the 2024 press figure and is unconfirmed by the company.
